# Fixnote

> End-to-end encrypted AI note-taking app for Windows, macOS, and the web. Local-first, offline-capable, with built-in AI assistant, on-device voice dictation, bot-free call summaries, OCR/PDF search, and MCP servers for AI agents.

## Pricing
- Free ($0, no account required): unlimited local notes, offline search, voice dictation, OCR, local MCP server (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex), import/export.
- Pro ($7/month or $60/year): end-to-end encrypted sync, Fixnote AI, shared notes and folders, remote MCP server for ChatGPT and claude.ai (https://mcp.fixnote.space/mcp), Telegram/Discord/browser capture, 20 GB encrypted storage.
